description: This header file defines classes and enums related to managing modem simulation channels, including client management and communication handling within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: ClientId
classes.description: Represents a unique identifier for a client connected to the channel monitor.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client connected to the modem channel, managing communication via shared file descriptors.

classes.name: ChannelMonitor
classes.description: Manages the communication channels between the modem simulator and clients, including accepting connections and sending commands.

methods.name: ClientId()
methods.description: Constructor for ClientId, initializes a new client ID.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for ClientId.

methods.name: Client()
methods.description: Default constructor for Client.

methods.name: Client(SharedFD)
methods.description: Constructor for Client with a single file descriptor.

methods.name: Client(SharedFD, SharedFD)
methods.description: Constructor for Client with read and write file descriptors.

methods.name: Client(SharedFD, ClientType)
methods.description: Constructor for Client with a file descriptor and client type.

methods.name: Client(SharedFD, SharedFD, ClientType)
methods.description: Constructor for Client with read/write descriptors and client type.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for Client.

methods.name: SendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a response string or list of responses to the client.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the unique ClientId.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the client type (RIL or REMOTE).

methods.name: ChannelMonitor()
methods.description: Constructor for ChannelMonitor, initializes monitoring with modem and server file descriptor.

methods.name: SetRemoteClient
methods.description: Associates a remote client with the monitor.

methods.name: SendRemoteCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a specified remote client.

methods.name: CloseRemoteConnection
methods.description: Closes the connection to a remote client.

methods.name: SendUnsolicitedCommand
methods.description: Sends an unsolicited command to clients.

methods.name: AcceptIncomingConnection
methods.description: Accepts incoming client connections.

methods.name: OnClientSocketClosed
methods.description: Handles closure of a client socket.

methods.name: ReadCommand
methods.description: Reads a command from a client.

methods.name: MonitorLoop
methods.description: Main loop for monitoring client activity.

methods.name: removeInvalidClients
methods.description: Removes invalid clients from the client list.
